name: superops-mcp
description: Every SuperOps PSA+RMM entity in your terminal, plus a local SQLite mirror that answers cross-entity questions the web UI can't.

superops_api_token.title: SUPEROPS_API_TOKEN
superops_api_token.description: Sets SUPEROPS_API_TOKEN for the SuperOps MCP server.

superops_subdomain.title: SuperOps subdomain
superops_subdomain.description: Your tenant subdomain (SuperOps: Settings > MSP Information). Sent as the CustomerSubdomain header on every call; requests without it are rejected.

superops_base_url.title: SuperOps API base URL
superops_base_url.description: Base URL for the SuperOps API. Leave the prefilled default unless your account uses a different regional or self-hosted host.

superops_region.title: SuperOps region
superops_region.description: Data-centre region your tenant lives in: us or eu. The wrong region answers with an authentication error.
